hyperedges.label: Core user features of Deeplink Manager

nodes.label: Built entirely offline; no network layer
nodes.rationale: App is offline-first by design; no network layer exists, so all behavior depends on local storage.
nodes.norm_label: built entirely offline; no network layer

nodes.label: Gradle 9.5.0 vs AGP 8.7.3/Kotlin 2.0.21 mismatch
nodes.rationale: Toolchain pins sit outside each other's officially supported ranges (Kotlin 2.0.21 supports Gradle up to 8.8); plugin-internal build failures are likely caused by this mismatch, not by code changes.

nodes.label: gradle/libs.versions.toml version catalog (libs.* aliases)
nodes.rationale: All dependencies are declared in the version catalog and referenced via libs.* aliases; never add inline coordinates.

nodes.label: Ungrouped system tag (fixed id 1)
nodes.rationale: Ungrouped is a system tag with fixed id 1 (TagEntity.UNGROUPED_ID), seeded in DeeplinkDatabase.onCreate; it must never be renamed or deleted (guards in TagRepositoryImpl and MainViewModel).

nodes.label: Tag delete reassigns deeplinks to Ungrouped
nodes.norm_label: tag delete reassigns deeplinks to ungrouped

nodes.label: Client-side duplicate URL guard
nodes.rationale: Duplicate URLs are only guarded client-side (MainViewModel.save via findIdByUrl); there is no DB unique index on url, so the guard must be kept when changing save logic.

nodes.label: Case-insensitive unique tag names
nodes.rationale: Tag names are unique case-insensitively via a unique DB index plus a TagNameDialog already-exists check.

nodes.label: DeeplinkRepository.upsert id==0 means insert
nodes.rationale: DeeplinkRepository.upsert treats id == 0L as insert, otherwise update; preserving this contract matters for the repository API.

nodes.label: Destructive Room migration wipes user data
nodes.rationale: Room uses fallbackToDestructiveMigration() and exportSchema = false: schema changes wipe user data and no migration scripts exist, so schema changes carry a high data-loss cost.
nodes.norm_label: destructive room migration wipes user data

nodes.label: Layers: ui/, data/local, data/repo, di, util
nodes.norm_label: layers: ui/, data/local, data/repo, di, util

nodes.label: Tech stack (Kotlin, Compose, MVVM/Clean, Hilt, Room)
nodes.norm_label: tech stack (kotlin, compose, mvvm/clean, hilt, room)

nodes.label: 100% offline, data never leaves device
nodes.rationale: No accounts, no sync, no analytics, no network calls - everything runs on local storage; privacy/offline is a core selling point for devs and QA.
